title: GPT-6.1 Terra halves OpenAI's API prices and still gains ground on its larger models
displayTitle: OpenAI发布GPT-6.1 Terra，API价格较前代减半
summary: The Decoder报道OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra，API价格较GPT-5.6 Terra降低约50%，主打视觉理解和电脑操作；价格及基准表现需按官方设定和具体任务比较，不能泛化为所有任务成本减半。
investorNote: 中档模型的价格和电脑操作能力一起推进，企业采购需看单任务完成成本而非单纯token单价。
narrative: OpenAI推出GPT-6.1 Terra，The Decoder核对其标准API价格较GPT-5.6 Terra降低一半，并强调视觉推理和电脑操作。官方给出的基准数据显示同价位能力上升，但任务完成成本还受推理强度、输出长度与失败重试影响。这个发布更值得看的，是中档模型开始正面承担桌面工作流：采购方应比较每个完成任务的成本和错误率，而不是只比每百万Token报价。

evidence.quote: OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a model it says pushes the cost-to-performance boundary further than any of its predecessors. API prices are half those of GPT-5.6 Terra.

Terra is OpenAI's closest competitor to Anthropic's mid-tier Sonnet series at half the price. Input tokens cost $1 per million, output tokens $5, compared to $2 and $10 for Claude Sonnet 5.5 and $2 and $12 for GPT-5.6 Terra. Cached inputs drop to just $0.05 per million tokens, a quarter of the previous rate.
